spec.title: Harden festina-quick with verification, retry, and parity fixes
spec.context: festina-quick lacks quality gates that other skills already have: no verification of done criteria after implementation, one-shot directive compliance with no retry loop, auto-decided research with no user override, manual [FESTINA_COMPLETE] instead of skill-complete partial, missing doc list/check command variants, and no approach confirmation before implementation. This creates risk of incomplete or incorrect quick task implementations.

in-scope.item: Add lightweight anti-pattern scan (TODO/FIXME/HACK) to quick skill after implementation
Add retry loop to the shared directive-compliance partial
Add research override option to quick's auto_decide_research step
Add approach confirmation pause before implementation begins
Add show_list_product and show_list_engineering flags to quick's context

out-of-scope.item: Full requirement trace or wiring verification (festina-implement scope)
Changes to other skills beyond the shared directive-compliance partial
Adding column-transition partial to quick (not needed for quick workflow)

delta.current: Quick skill (SKILL.md, 322 lines) has: auto_decide_research that silently decides without override, determine_approach that outputs approach without confirmation pause, directive-compliance partial that offers fix/continue with no retry, inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE] output, and product/engineering doc scripts with only search variants (no list).
delta.changing: auto_decide_research gains an override option when deciding "simple". determine_approach gains a confirmation step. A new verify_implementation step scans modified files for anti-patterns. directive-compliance partial gains a retry loop. Output uses skill-complete partial. Doc script partials gain list flags.
delta.unchanged: Quick's core Q&A flow (problem + done), quick.xml structure, optional_research step, detect_docs step, validate_xml step. Other skills' usage of directive-compliance partial (they gain the retry loop automatically but behavior is backward-compatible — the retry only activates when user selects "Fix now").

requirements.requirement: Quick skill output_result step uses the skill-complete partial instead of inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE] text
Quick skill context section includes show_list_product=true and show_list_engineering=true flags on the respective doc script partials

The shared directive-compliance partial includes a retry loop: when a check fails and user selects "Fix now", the fix is applied and failed checks re-run; if still failing after remediation, the result is reported to user and execution continues

After implementation completes and before directive compliance, modified files from quick.xml files section are scanned for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers and user is warned with file:line references if any are found
The anti-pattern scan only greps files listed in quick.xml files section, excluding markers in unmodified files
When auto_decide_research determines the task is simple, the user is shown the decision with a single override option to research anyway
After determine_approach displays the approach, user is presented a confirmation prompt to proceed or adjust before implementation begins
When no directives are loaded, directive compliance passes silently without presenting any retry or fix prompts

file.reason: Add verification step, research override, approach confirmation, skill-complete partial usage, doc list flags
Add retry loop (fix → re-run failed checks → report if still failing)

pattern.name: Anti-pattern scan
pattern.description: Grep modified files for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers, present findings with file:line, offer fix/proceed choice

pattern.name: Handlebars partial flags
pattern.description: Conditional sections in partials controlled by show_* boolean flags passed from skill context

pattern.name: Directive compliance with retry
pattern.description: festina-implement's inline pattern: fix violation → re-run failed checks → report if still failing

product.finding: Fast path for simple fixes. Currently uses 8 of 10 partials — missing skill-complete and column-transition. Only has search doc commands, not list.
Full implementation skill with verify_implementation_quality step including anti-pattern scan at line 368 — reference pattern for quick's lightweight verification.

engineering.finding: Handlebars compilation from src/content/ to dist/. Partials auto-register by filename. skill-complete partial is a single-line drop-in replacement.

codebase.finding: 322-line skill source. Lines 93-107: auto_decide_research (no override). Lines 163-174: determine_approach (no confirmation). Line 235: inline [FESTINA_COMPLETE].
37-line shared partial. Has fix/continue but no retry loop after fix. Used by 16 of 17 skills.
Single line: outputs [FESTINA_COMPLETE]. Drop-in replacement for quick's inline version.

pitfall.issue: Retry loop in shared partial affects all 16 skills
pitfall.mitigation: Behavior is backward-compatible — retry only activates when user selects Fix now, which is already the existing flow. The change adds re-run after fix instead of just continuing.

pitfall.issue: Anti-pattern scan must exclude unmodified files
pitfall.mitigation: Only grep files listed in quick.xml files section

constraints.constraint: Keep quick lightweight — verification is a quick scan, not interactive behavior-by-behavior testing
Approach confirmation is a simple proceed/adjust prompt, not a full spec review
Research override is a single option, not a multi-step flow
Edit source in apps/festinalente/src/content/ (not .claude/ or .opencode/ built output)

risk.mitigation: Retry only activates on user-initiated fix, preserving existing flow
